venues.name: Kalshi
venues.notes: CFTC-regulated DCM. Taker ceil(0.07*C*P*(1-P)); most sports series are maker-free. Verify the live schedule before sizing.

venues.name: Polymarket
venues.notes: CLOB, USDC-settled. No trading fee on the book historically; real cost is the on/off ramp and gas. Oracle resolution, not league-official -- read the resolution text per market.
